ezinsar.eicomponents.processor.isce2module

package documentation
(source)

Module for the ISCE-2 processor wrapper for EZ-InSAR

The module contains the different sub-modules to run ezinsar with ISCE (version 2) processor.

Changelog:
  • 1.2.0: New checking of S1 orbit, Aug. 2025, Alexis Hrysiewicz
  • 1.1.0: Start the supports of CSK, RSAT-2, Feb. 2025, Alexis Hrysiewicz
  • 1.0.0: Initial version, Dec. 2024
Module isce2coregistration Module to manage the class for coregistration processing using ISCE-2
Module isce2ifgstack Module to manage the class for interferometric processing using ISCE-2
Module isce2IWfunction Module to process ScanSAR data with ISCE-2 processor
Module isce2StripMapfunction Module to process ScanSAR data with ISCE-2 processor
Module isce2tools Module to add some tool functions for ISCE-2 processor
